name: Matched FLAN-T5 readers after rebuilt document retrieval
status: Exploratory follow-up on reused issuers; not external confirmation
selection: Structure chunking is chosen after seeing the earlier symbolic study. Publish both models, all arms and every variant regardless of results.
reader: Original infer_input, decode and LocalGenerator functions; source cells parsed only from the saved top-five raw chunks of each rebuilt ranking
unit_intent: Resolve from question text using the existing symbolic question parser; no expected-value or annotated-unit fallback
cell_ids: Opaque globally shuffled IDs over source document/page/row-label/metric/period keys; duplicate chunk copies coalesced only if values and units agree
comparisons: Within each model and decoding arm, compare native versus unit-neutral retrieval on original numeric accuracy and paired original/rescaled accuracy. Also retain all four decoding arms to expose the original accuracy tradeoff.
scoring: Expected numeric value from original question annotation; target coordinate requires annotated source page, metric and period. All questions remain in denominators; refusals and invalid outputs are numeric failures.
limits: Same 15 development and 35 test questions; no new independent sample
Same small FLAN-T5 family, not a model-diversity evaluation
Reconstructed statement text with a restricted five-metric parser
Cells now come from complete top-five chunks, unlike the original pilot's expanded source pages; absolute results are not interchangeable
No synthetic result establishes real XBRL, restatement or raw-PDF handling
No significance or first-ever novelty claim; configuration chosen after earlier exploratory results
